---
description: "Resume the living prototype baseline, pending diagnostic questions, or an approved prototype change without losing history."
agent: Prototype Change Partner
---

Follow [the prototype agent contract](../agents/prototype-change-partner.agent.md).
Read `prototype-docs/state.md` first, then relevant baseline requirements,
decisions, diagnostic questions and in-progress change contracts.

Summarize what is observed vs confirmed, the last actual approval, unanswered
questions and the next bounded action. If initial diagnostic review is pending,
offer the first unresolved question batch; do not start a net-new feature.
If a change is approved, verify its scope and worktree before resuming.
If state conflicts with artifacts, report the discrepancy and ask before
advancing. Never invent approvals or overwrite answers to restart a workflow.
